dict.Datele modelului sunt într-un fișier sep: The model data is in a separate file (.bin) next to the .gltf; choose the .glb version, with everything in one file.
dict.Fișierul .ply are doar puncte (o scanare: The .ply file only has points (a scan without faces), no faces to draw.
dict.Fișierul .ply are un tip de date necunos: The .ply file has an unknown data type.
dict.Fișierul .ply nu poate fi citit (lipseșt: The .ply file cannot be read (the "ply … end_header" header is missing).
dict.Fișierul glTF nu are niciun obiect de de: The glTF file has no object to draw.
dict.Fișierul glTF nu are triunghiuri de dese: The glTF file has no triangles to draw.
The glTF file cannot be read.
dict.Modelul glTF e comprimat (Draco / meshop: The glTF model is compressed (Draco / meshopt) and cannot be read; save it from the 3D program without compression.
dict.Alege un model 3D (.obj, .stl, .glb / .g: Choose a 3D model (.obj, .stl, .glb / .gltf or .ply, for example a designed part, an object for a 3D printer or a scan), rotate it with the mouse and insert it as a picture.
